purpose: Fail closed if DanchiHighDetail LOD proxy render state can diverge from the metric physical-UV source state and create texture-phase, material-response or microdetail snapping. This contract is source/evidence integrity only and awards no Visual Fidelity points without native Unity pixels.

reviewFor: visible texture phase or manufacture-grain scale snap during LOD transition
material response or reflection discontinuity across a cross-fade
micro-normal shimmer or moire introduced by LOD switching
component disappearance that reads as a distracting visible LOD pop

limitations: Exact mesh/material/transform identity can prevent source-to-proxy physical-UV drift but cannot prove a cross-fade is visually invisible.
Renderer omission is the current LOD reduction strategy; silhouette quality and disappearing-detail salience require native rendered motion evidence.
Shared metric UVs do not by themselves prove anisotropic filtering, mip selection or normal-map response is stable at every transition distance.
The canonical 3840x2160 temporal probes and 100 percent crops remain authoritative for visible LOD pop, shimmer and material-response continuity.
